label: Quotient Chat — the agent panel
description: THE Quotient agent chat panel (built from actual screenshots) -- the SAME surface that appears as the right panel of quotient-app-shell; place THIS component over the shell's panel slot for full fidelity (shell show_panel: false, panel slot = x shellX+0.68·shellW, y shellY+0.062·shellH, w 0.31·shellW, h 0.90·shellH; with the standard inset shell that is x 67.6%, y 8%, width 30.5%, height 87%). White rounded panel with the TAB ROW (active tab underlined with ×, optional second tab with the spinning ✳ = a running chat, copies icon with count badge -> References popover, split, ×), the transcript, and the composer (Type a message..., paperclip, Auto, mic, gray send). THE TRANSCRIPT GRAMMAR (all color-coded by entity): verb-line ('Reviewed [in] LinkedIn post' + bold title, or inline 'Created ✉ Weekly AI Marketing Newsletter July 13 2026'); content-card -- the STREAMING box: 'Created/Updated [entity] ...' header + bold title + chevron, and the document content STREAMS word-by-word into a white inner box whose older lines slide up under a top fade (the live-edit treatment for posts/docs/emails/memory); task-status ('Marked 1 task(s) as ◑ In review' + blue-checkbox task rows); agent prose; user bubbles (right-aligned, pink initials avatar); 'Conversation summarized' divider. Entity icons: linkedin (blue tile), x (black tile), email + doc/template (orange), task + campaign (blue), blog/memory (dark). SCRIPTED performable surface; camera anchors: messages, composer, tabs.

tabs.label: Tab row: [{label, running?: true (spinning ✳, muted)}]. First tab is active with the ×.

copies_badge.label: Count badge on the copies icon (default 2)

user_initials.label: User bubble avatar initials (default 'JM', pink disc)

user_avatar_url.label: User bubble avatar photo (covers the initials)

history.label: Transcript at open: [{type: 'user'|'agent'|'verb-line'|'content-card'|'task-status'|'summarized', ...same params as the script actions}] -- content-card takes content (rendered instantly) and open: false to start collapsed.

script.label: The performance: type-message {text} + send-message, user-message {text}, show-typing/hide-typing, agent-message {text} (**bold** + `code`), verb-line {verb: 'Reviewed'|'Created'|'Updated'|'Marked', entity: 'linkedin'|'x'|'email'|'doc'|'template'|'task'|'campaign'|'blog'|'memory', title, inline_title?: true (title on the verb line, like 'Created ✉ Weekly AI Marketing Newsletter July 13 2026'), noun?}, content-card {verb, entity, title, content: 'the doc text...\n\n...', duration: 3, collapse_delay?} (THE streaming beat: the content types itself into the faded box while the scroll-down button floats), task-status {status: 'In review', tasks: ['Draft LinkedIn POV post'], count}, summarized {label?}, open-references {items: [{entity, title, kind: 'Social Post'|'Task'|...}]} / close-references (the popover under the copies icon), switch-tab {index}. Plus base actions (move-cursor, click, wait). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (messages, composer, tabs). Also: error-line {text} (circled-x failure row), search-card {query, results: [{title, desc}]} (tool search-results card), tool-use {tool_name, service} (MCP tool chip).

mode.label: panel (default, compact sidebar) | full (the expanded full-screen thread: centered content column, roomier type)

script_actions.description: Post the typed text as a user bubble (pink initials avatar above, white bordered bubble)
Color-coded did-a-thing line: muted verb + entity icon + noun, bold title beneath (or inline_title for one-liners)

THE streaming box: 'Created/Updated [entity]' header + bold title + chevron; the content STREAMS word-by-word into the white inner box, older lines sliding up under the top fade; the floating scroll-down button shows while streaming
'Marked N task(s) as ◑ In review' + blue-checkbox task rows
References popover under the copies icon: entity icon + title + kind per row
Move the active underline to another tab
